title: Staff Backend Engineer, Performance Enablement
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Staff Backend Engineer in GitLab's Performance Enablement group, you'll define and build the self-serve platform that lets GitLab engineering teams own their performance. You'll give internal teams the tooling and guidance to run performance tests, analyze results, track trends, and meet their own performance requirements throughout the development lifecycle. We're a platform, not a consulting service: we build capabilities that teams use independently to deliver a reliable, performant GitLab to customers. In this hands-on technical leadership role, you'll work with the Engineering Manager to shape a multi-quarter vision and roadmap, bringing your performance engineering expertise to influence teams across research and development (R&D).</p> <p>Some examples of our projects in <a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/developer-experience/performance-enablement/">Performance Enablement</a>:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building reusable component-level testing, load testing, performance analysis, trend visibility, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted engineering skills</li> <li value="2">Enabling teams to test performance throughout the development lifecycle, from local development and continuous integration (CI) workflows through pre-release validation, including modular feature teams' own workflows</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Define the team's technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap with the Engineering Manager, identify opportunities for impact across R&D, and advocate for technical priorities with stakeholders.</li> <li value="2">Design and build reusable platform capabilities for performance testing, analysis, reporting, and trend visibility, solving complex technical problems and shipping large capabilities with minimal guidance.</li> <li value="3">Turn lessons from early team engagements into reusable capabilities, documentation, and onboarding, measured by each new team needing less hands-on support than the last until teams can adopt the platform and manage their performance independently.</li> <li value="4">Coordinate with peer teams across Developer Experience, Infrastructure Platforms, and product groups to align priorities and timing.</li> <li value="5">Lead AI-first development practices in how we build and what we ship, including AI skills and agent-assisted performance workflows.</li> <li value="6">Mentor engineers in performance engineering, platform design, and technical decision-making.</li> <li value="7">Serve as a performance expert for other teams and provide technical guidance on initiatives spanning multiple groups.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Staff-level backend or platform engineering experience, including setting technical direction across a team and the teams around it.</li> <li value="2">A track record of building and operating performance testing and analysis systems, with an understanding of where bottlenecks appear and how to find them.</li> <li value="3">Experience leading or anchoring a performance enablement or platform function and achieving measurable adoption of internal tooling by influencing engineers and leaders who don't report to you.</li> <li value="4">Experience defining and delivering a multi-quarter technical strategy or roadmap with engineering leadership.</li> <li value="5">An AI-first development mindset demonstrated across the software lifecycle, including shaping how a team uses AI.</li> <li value="6">Hands-on experience with load and performance testing tools such as k6 or equivalent, Kubernetes, and Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud infrastructure.</li> <li value="7">Clear written, asynchronous communication, including explaining performance trade-offs to engineers and leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p><a class="textLink" href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/developer-experience/performance-enablement/">Performance title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes. Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services. Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data. What They're Looking For A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-8 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both. Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations. Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments. A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use. Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements. Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice. A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently. Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers. You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection. If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you. title: Regional Sales Director - EMEA
description: About Energy Exemplar In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include: SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together. About the Position As a senior sales leader within Energy Exemplar’s EMEA Sales team, the Regional Sales Director - Trading is responsible for leading growth of PLEXOS and related solutions across power and gas trading organisations in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This role combines frontline sales leadership with direct involvement in the region’s most strategic opportunities. The successful candidate will lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Executives while building senior relationships with power traders, trading desks, utilities, energy retailers, and other energy-market participants. They will bring strong enterprise software sales expertise, energy-market knowledge, and a deep understanding of how trading organisations use modelling, simulation, optimisation, and analytics to make strategic decisions. This is a unique opportunity to work with leading energy-trading organisations, help them unlock the full potential of Energy Exemplar’s PLEXOS software suite, and shape the future of energy-market simulation across EMEA. Build strategic market relationships: Develop executive-level relationships with trading organisations, utilities, partners, and industry influencers to create a robust pipeline and position Energy Exemplar as a trusted adviser in the energy simulation space. Primary Responsibilities Sales Leadership and Team Development Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Executives focused on power and gas trading customers across EMEA. Establish clear individual and regional goals, sales plans, and performance expectations. Drive sales discipline across opportunity qualification, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and deal execution. Support team members in complex sales cycles, executive engagements, proposals, negotiations, and strategic account development. Recruit, onboard, and retain high-calibre sales talent as the EMEA Trading business grows. Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and customer-focused sales culture. Regional Business Development and Sales Execution Own the EMEA Trading regional sales strategy and execution plan, aligned to company growth objectives. Identify and qualify new business opportunities across EMEA, with particular focus on power and gas trading organisations, utilities, energy retailers, and energy-intensive organisations. Develop and execute strategic account plans for priority organisations and target market segments. Lead discovery sessions with senior stakeholders to understand their commercial, operational, and technical challenges. Clearly articulate how PLEXOS solutions address trading, market modelling, portfolio optimisation, forecasting, and risk-management requirements. Prepare and support persuasive executive presentations, demonstrations, proposals, and business cases. Lead or support commercial negotiations involving contracts, pricing, and terms to close high-value new business opportunities. Partner with the Solutions team to coordinate effective proof-of-concept studies that demonstrate PLEXOS capabilities. Ensure accurate forecasting of sales activity, pipeline, and revenue through CRM tools. Market Intelligence and Strategic Planning Monitor and analyse market trends, competitive activity, regulatory developments, and customer needs across EMEA power and gas markets. Identify emerging opportunities within power trading and broader energy-market segments. Use market and sales data to guide territory strategy, resource allocation, and sales-performance improvement. Provide feedback to Product, Marketing, and senior leadership on market requirements, competitive positioning, and customer priorities. Contribute to the development and execution of regional go-to-market strategies. Represent Energy Exemplar at industry events, conferences, and webinars to build brand awareness and senior customer relationships. Support thought-leadership activity on energy trading, modelling, and simulation topics. Customer and Partner Relationship Management Build and maintain strong executive relationships with key decision-makers and influencers in target accounts. Act as a trusted commercial adviser to customers on energy-market modelling and simulation best practices. Collaborate with Solutions and Customer Success teams to ensure a strong transition from sale to implementation and customer adoption. Work with partners, including consulting firms and system integrators, to develop joint value propositions and market opportunities. Identify and pursue cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the customer base. Ensure a consistently high standard of customer engagement across the regional team. Candidate Requirements & Qualifications 8+ years of successful enterprise B2B software sales experience, preferably within the energy sector. 2+ years of sales leadership experience, including coaching and managing quota-carrying Sales Executives. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team revenue targets and closing complex, high-value new business deals. Strong understanding of energy markets, power and gas trading operations, and market fundamentals. Experience selling complex software solutions to power trading organisations, utilities, energy retailers, or energy-intensive organisations. Demonstrated ability to build and execute regional sales strategies and strategic account plans. Strong executive presence, with excellent presentation, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills. Experience navigating complex procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation processes. Proficiency with CRM systems, sales methodologies, forecasting, and sales analytics. description: This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in Italy. You will work closely with client stakeholders, technical leaders, and delivery teams to build, and roll out agentic capabilities that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise systems and frameworks. What we are looking for in this person: Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level. Our Seniors typically have at least 8 years of commercial experience. Experience designing and building agentic platforms using Python and modern AI frameworks. Architect LLM orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and related technologies. Implement multi-agent systems supporting tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and decision-making. Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines integrating enterprise data sources. Integrate agentic platforms with client systems, including APIs, data platforms, cloud services, and enterprise applications. The ability to configure Kubernetes and deploy workloads. Design deployment architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments. Ability to collaborate efficiently in teams of technical and non-technical individuals. Comfort working in a dynamic environment with evolving objectives and direct iteration with users. Strong consulting experience to plan, execute, and deliver complex client engagements, solving real business problems. Nice to have: Hands-on experience working with Golang Hands-on experience in the Frontend working with React Deep understanding of Kubernetes Benefits & Perks: Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 28 days plus public holidays. Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join. Pension & Insurances - We provide statutory pension and access to a collective complementary pension scheme (CCNL-based, with employer contribution up to 1.55%), plus Death in Service cover. Our Interview Process Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom) An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. title: Staff Software Engineer (L4)
description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff SRE, Platform Engineering About the job Twilio is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform Engineering organization. SRE owns production health and resiliency at Twilio — we are accountable for whether our services stay available, performant, and recoverable for the customers who build their businesses on us. SREs here are software engineers who focus on reliability: you will architect systems with reliability designed in from the outset, define the SLIs and SLOs that determine whether we are meeting customer expectations, and build the automation that keeps our infrastructure efficiently ahead of capacity and performance demand. At the Staff SRE you work without day-to-day guidance, applying deep subject-matter knowledge and industry-leading practice to improve the products, processes, and services that Twilio runs on. You will own the reliability posture of significant parts of our production estate. Your impact will be felt across multiple teams rather than within one. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write and deploy code that improves service reliability, orchestrate complex changes across systems, lead the response when production is degraded, and raise the quality bar for the engineers around you. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Own the reliability posture of production services in your area — availability, latency, capacity, efficiency, performance, and the monitoring and alerting that makes them visible Define, instrument, and operate against SLIs and SLOs, and use error budgets to drive engineering priorities Identify trends and problem areas that threaten stability, and provide a path forward to mitigate risk before it reaches customers Drive down repair items and prevent classes of incidents rather than resolving them one at a time Improve detection, response, and recovery — reducing time to acknowledge, engage, mitigate, and restore, with fewer people pulled in Design for failure: strengthen failure domains, validate recovery paths, and make production changes safer to ship and safer to roll back Participate in on-call for the services you support, and lead the response when production is degraded Write post-mortems that identify true root causes, and drive the follow-up work to completion Oversee efforts to identify, diagnose, report, and document production problems across all reliability dimensions Write, configure, and deploy code that measurably improves service reliability — maintainable, reviewed, documented, and well tested Orchestrate complex changes across systems and services, documenting design changes, technical decisions, migration plans, and upgrades Lead debugging, troubleshooting, and analysis of service architecture and design Use code review to drive up the quality of your coworkers' code Reduce the operational overhead required to run infrastructure and services Drive projects from conception to completion for efforts spanning the concerns of your team Coordinate across programs, collaborating with others to estimate and communicate delivery timelines Break projects into milestones and tasks, track progress, and communicate updates to stakeholders Identify and communicate changes that may impact stability Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 8+ years of related engineering experience, with a substantial portion focused on reliability, infrastructure, or platform engineering Demonstrated accountability for production systems — you have carried a pager for services that mattered and owned the outcome when they failed Strong software engineering fundamentals: you build and ship production code, not only configure tooling Experience defining and operating against SLIs and SLOs, and using error budgets to inform engineering priorities Depth in production operations: incident command, post-mortem analysis, capacity planning, and observability A record of preventing recurrence — reducing incident classes and operational toil, not just closing tickets Experience driving changes that span multiple teams, and the communication skills to build alignment without formal authority A track record of improving the engineers around you through code review, design feedback, and mentorship Experience with large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment Desired: Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, and GitOps-style delivery Experience with multi-region architecture, failure-domain design, or regional expansion work Background in chaos engineering, game days, or other proactive resilience validation Location This role will be remote, and based in Ireland. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Company Operations Lead
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves. As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges. You’ll be responsible for: Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning. Operating System : Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team. AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right. Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done. Requirements We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require: Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent). Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue. Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence. Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it. Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment. Bonus: Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection. Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building. Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline. Location This role is remote. London or New York preferred. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes
description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨ Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐ We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service. We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service. 🔑You’ll play a key role by... You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation. Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts. Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect. Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark. Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts. Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners. Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor. Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset. 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if… You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract. You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in. You have a proven track record of leading through others and can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you. You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams. You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business. Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you! 🙌 What’s in it for you 💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences. 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits . 🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps Recruiter call (25 minutes) Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes) Role Specific Interview (60 minutes) This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here. We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. #LI-REMOTE #LI-CB4 Equal opportunities for everyone Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Customer Success Manager - EMEA
description: About Energy Exemplar In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include: SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards. Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards. IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards. How We Work Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move. We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role. Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together. About the Role As a member of the EMEA Customer Success team, the Customer Success Manager will be responsible for managing and growing customer engagements across the region. This role will focus on building and maintaining long-term strategic partnerships with utilities, regulators, government bodies, and energy companies, ensuring Energy Exemplar’s solutions deliver measurable value. The successful candidate will oversee a high-value customer portfolio with a clear mandate to drive customer retention, revenue growth, and advocacy. You will act as the trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, proactively identifying opportunities for expansion through upsell and cross-sell initiatives, while ensuring adoption and satisfaction remain at best-in-class levels. This role also requires strong external engagement, representing Energy Exemplar as a thought leader at industry events, government forums, and conferences across EMEA. To succeed, you will combine a strong commercial mindset with deep knowledge of the regional energy landscape and an ability to translate complex customer challenges into actionable solutions. Primary Responsibilities Strategic Account Ownership Establish, expand, and nurture executive-level relationships with customers across EMEA. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders in utilities, regulators, government bodies, and energy companies. Take full ownership of all accounts in the region to ensure long-term retention, growth, and advocacy. Revenue Growth & Retention Drive measurable business outcomes by managing a regional portfolio. Ensure renewal targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Proactively identify expansion opportunities through upsell and cross-sell initiatives to maximize customer lifetime value. Customer Advocacy & Success Partner closely with customers to understand their evolving priorities and ensure Energy Exemplar’s solutions deliver strategic value. Achieve industry-leading retention rates while securing multiple customer testimonials and reference partnerships annually. Market & Industry Engagement Represent Energy Exemplar as a thought leader in the EMEA energy sector. Attend and present at regional conferences, government forums, and industry events to expand networks and identify emerging opportunities. Operational Excellence Ensure customer onboarding, adoption, and expansion are delivered to the highest standard, leveraging consistent frameworks across markets. Maintain robust account management systems, driving insights through structured reporting and data analysis to executive leadership. Voice of the Customer Act as the key conduit between customers and Energy Exemplar’s Product teams. Deliver actionable feedback on market trends, regulatory developments, and customer requirements, shaping product innovation and roadmap priorities. Regional Expansion & Innovation Identify and develop new business opportunities, including strategic partnerships with governments, regulators, and private sector leaders. Requirements Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Consulting. Previous experience in SaaS/software is essential. Industry Knowledge: Experience selling into the energy sector is a strong plus but not essential. An interest in the energy landscape and the ability to understand industry dynamics and customer needs are advantageous. Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of managing enterprise accounts and meeting or exceeding renewal, retention, and expansion targets. Relationship Management: Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong executive-level relationships with C-suite and senior stakeholders. Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate customer challenges into actionable solutions, drive adoption, and deliver measurable customer value. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior audiences and representing the company at industry forums. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in using data to generate customer insights, monitor account performance, and inform strategic decisions. Flexibility: Willingness to travel across EMEA for customer meetings, industry events, and regional engagements. Education: Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in business, engineering, or a related field is preferred Based in the UK. Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential. Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.

title: Engagement Manager, Life Sciences
description: Who we are At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai What we are building Domino's Solutions team is the customer-facing engine behind how leading enterprises build, scale, and govern AI-powered applications - solving real business challenges, not just deploying technology. Solutions Engineering earns technical credibility before the deal closes. Customer Engineering, where this role lives, owns everything after: adoption, implementation, expansion, and the kind of delivery that makes customers renew and grow. Global Support and SRE keeps it all running at the level enterprise customers depend on. Three functions, one relentless motion, and a team that earns its reputation on what it ships, not what it scopes. What your impact will be Own the customer program end-to-end: from contract signature through expansion. You're accountable for outcomes, not activities, and every engagement you lead has a single owner (you), clear milestones, and a cadence that keeps everyone (internally and externally) moving as the program manager. Partner with account team to ensure every engagement is scoped to be delivered with excellence, bridging what is sold with what can be executed. Direct the delivery pod (our Forward Deployed Engineers and Integration & Architecture teams) for customer engagements. Put capacity where it creates the most value and keep programs on track across milestones, stakeholder communication, and account health. Earn trust at every level: from C-suite sponsors to the data scientists running models in production. You close the gap between strategic intent and day-to-day delivery. Lead the room in solutioning conversations: connect how Domino builds, scales, and governs AI to the outcomes customer leadership actually cares about. You operate as a peer, not a vendor. Make adoption real: drive rollout, enablement, and change management so what your team ships gets used, not shelved. Turn customer engagements into growth in partnership with customer success and sales — proactively uncovering new use cases and expansion opportunities, qualifying them, and routing them back to internal teams to fuel pipeline. Be the customer's voice inside Domino: convert field intelligence into product feedback, escalations, and commercial signals that make the broader team smarter. What we look for in this role 4–8 years in an enterprise customer-facing discipline: implementations, consulting, technical program management, or product. Caliber and complexity matter more than the title. Background in life sciences where reproducibility, auditability, and compliance are non-negotiable is a meaningful advantage. Comfortable owning the what , not just the when : you can reshape a customer's ask into the right solution, even when that means pushing back on the original scope You move before the problem is fully formed: comfortable when the customer can't yet articulate what's wrong and treating ambiguity as the starting point. You turn unstructured executive conversations into executable plans: connecting model development, deployment, and governance without losing what actually matters. You know enough about how enterprise data science teams build, scale, and govern models to ask the right questions before the customer knows they need to answer them. Real delivery ownership across full cycles, not coordination. You hold an execution rhythm, hold a position when things get hard, and don't create bureaucracy to do it. Technically fluent across software architecture, predictive modeling, and agentic systems: able to get hands-on when it matters and learn new domains fast. Solutions-oriented by default. You escalate with a recommendation, not just a problem, and reach for AI to do all of it faster and better. What we value We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company #LI-Remote

title: Field Intelligence Analyst (Remote, UAE)
description: About Sayari : Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. title: JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant
description: JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant Particle41 is seeking a talented and versatile JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant to join our innovative team. We are staffing a dedicated consultant for a large enterprise client that runs JD Edwards as its core ERP. The client needs someone who knows the JDE data model inside and out and can build reliable data pipelines around it. This is a working seat on the client team, not a short advisory project. You will work shoulder to shoulder with their ERP, IT, and business teams every day. In This Role, You Will: Own JDE data work: Extract, model, and transform data from JD Edwards tables (Address Book, Item Master, Sales Order, General Ledger, and related files). Build data pipelines: Design and maintain ETL/ELT flows from JDE into the client's data warehouse or reporting platform. Support ERP implementation work: Lead data mapping, conversion, cleansing, and reconciliation for implementation, upgrade, or migration efforts. Support cutover planning and execution. Enable reporting: Build clean, trusted datasets for BI dashboards and finance and operations reporting. Protect data quality: Set up validation and reconciliation checks between JDE and downstream systems. Find and fix root causes. Partner with the business: Work with finance, distribution, and manufacturing users to turn their questions into data requirements. Document as you go: Keep data flows, mappings, and conversion rules clear and current for the client team. Skills and Experience We Value: 5+ years of hands-on JD Edwards experience (EnterpriseOne and/or World). Deep knowledge of the JDE data model and table structures is required for this role. Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400). Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling. At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work. Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing. Able to work full-time during US business hours. Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders. Able to work as an independent contractor. Nice to Have JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid. Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt. BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE. Python for data processing and automation. Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket. Oracle JD Edwards certification. Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: You understand the client's JDE footprint, key tables, and current data flows. You deliver a first pipeline or dataset fix. First 90 days: The client team trusts your data. Reporting and conversion work runs on documented, repeatable pipelines. Ongoing: You are the go-to person for JDE data questions on the client team. title: Finance & Strategy Manager

We are a lean team that moves fast, and we use SQL and AI tools like Claude to automate the manual work so we can spend our time on analysis and strategy. Investment banking or private equity experience (Analyst or Associate) is preferred Advanced financial modeling skills: three-statement models, DCF, scenario and sensitivity analysis. Expert in Excel / Google Sheets Solid understanding of accounting and how the three financial statements connect Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance partners and present confidently to senior leaders Working knowledge of SQL, or a demonstrated ability to pick up technical tools quickly Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to work faster and automate repetitive work Strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity and a builder mindset. title: Applications Engineering Manager (West Coast)
description: About Standard Bots Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. Someone has to make sure those robots actually work -- and someone has to build the team that makes that happen at scale. That's this role. Note: This position is technically remote, but is territory based and requires you to live on the West Coast. This role also requires up to 25% domestic travel. You're still in the field -- just not living out of a suitcase 2-3 days a week. Also note: Like every Applications Engineer at Standard Bots, this is not a software engineering role. You are a hands-on industrial automation engineer who also happens to lead people. If you've never commissioned a robotic cell, this isn't the right seat. The Role The Applications Engineering Manager is a player-coach. You still know your way around a factory floor -- fixtures, I/O, ladder logic, robot programming, all the things -- and you use that expertise every day, both to stay sharp and to earn the respect of the team you're leading. You'll manage a team of Applications Engineers across your territory, owning their development, their workload, and the quality of every customer engagement they touch. You'll be the escalation point when installs get complicated, the person who jumps on a plane when a customer situation needs senior eyes, and the one who sets the standard for what great applications engineering looks like at Standard Bots. This is still a hands-on role. You're not managing from a desk. You're leading from the front. You'll report directly to the VP of Applications Engineering. What You'll Do Team Leadership & Development - Manage and develop a team of Applications Engineers across your territory -- setting expectations, coaching on technical and customer-facing skills, and building a team that executes at a high level - Own capacity planning and workload distribution across your team -- making sure the right engineer is on the right job and nobody is drowning - Be the technical and cultural standard-setter for your team; the bar you hold yourself to is the bar your team rises to - Conduct regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning -- you invest in your people's growth, not just their output Territory & Customer Ownership - Own the applications engineering function for your territory -- from pre-sales POC support through post-install customer success - Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex integrations, difficult customer situations, or installs that aren't going as planned - Partner closely with your Regional Sales Manager on territory priorities, pipeline, and customer strategy -- you're the technical counterpart to their commercial leadership - Maintain strong relationships with key customer accounts in your territory; they should know you by name and trust your judgment Hands-On Technical Work - Stay sharp and stay in it -- you're still designing solutions, reviewing integrations, commissioning cells, and supporting installs when the situation calls for it - Lead or co-lead technically complex or strategically important customer engagements yourself - Review and sign off on solution designs, POCs, and integration plans produced by your team - Travel to customer sites as needed -- up to 25% domestically -- for escalations, key installs, and customer relationship moments Standards & Continuous Improvement - Define and enforce the standard for how applications engineering work gets done in your territory -- documentation, handoffs, commissioning checklists, customer training quality - Feed territory-level learnings back to the broader applications engineering organization and to product and engineering teams - Help build the playbooks, templates, and training materials that make every AE on your team better and every deployment more repeatable What We're Looking For - The same trifecta as our Applications Engineers -- you're genuinely fluent across mechanical, electrical, and software: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems, robot programming, Python scripting, CAD - 5+ years of hands-on applications engineering, systems integration, or automation engineering experience -- you've done the field work and done it well - 2+ years of people management or team lead experience -- you've led engineers, given hard feedback, and helped someone grow - Strong customer-facing presence -- you can manage a difficult customer conversation, set expectations clearly, and represent Standard Bots credibly at a senior level - Experience managing a distributed team or territory; you know how to lead people you don't see every day - Comfort with up to 25% domestic travel for escalations, key customer engagements, and team support - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story Nice to Have - Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar) - Background scaling an applications engineering or field engineering function -- you've helped build something, not just inherited it - Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling - Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications Compensation and Benefits The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $200,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

title: Senior Applications Engineer (West Coast)
description: About Standard Bots Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. Note: This role is technically remote, but you must live on the west coast (preference for California). This job is customer-facing and requires up to 50% domestic travel, Monday through Friday. If that makes you nervous, this probably isn't the right fit. If that sounds like a perk, read on. Also note: This is not a software engineering role. If you're looking for a job where you sit at a desk and write application code, this is the wrong job description. If you want to actually build things, wire things up, and watch them run -- keep reading. The Role The Senior Applications Engineer is one of the rarest profiles in industrial automation -- and one of the most important roles at Standard Bots. You're not a mechanical engineer. You're not an electrical engineer. You're not a software engineer. You're all three, and you know how to make them talk to each other. You can look at a customer's production line, understand what's broken or slow or manual, and figure out how to fix it with a robot. Then you build the proof of concept, get on a plane, and go install it. From pre to post sale, you're the one working closely with the sales team to make the solution real. You'll build the proof of concept, design the integration, write the python scripts, build the fixture, run the wiring, and commission the cell -- then train the customer's team on how to use it. You'll also help run demos at trade shows, support trainings at customer sites and in our shop, and be the technical backbone for every customer engagement that requires hands-on expertise. This is a builder's role. Tinkerers welcome. People who get bored at a desk are strongly encouraged to apply. What You'll Do Solution Design & Proof of Concept - Work with the sales team and customers to understand automation goals, production constraints, and integration requirements - Design practical, buildable solutions around Standard Bots' hardware -- and build the proof of concept yourself to validate it works before anyone signs anything - Develop application notes, sample code, and supporting documentation that help customers and internal teams understand how to replicate and scale solutions Field Installation & Integration - Travel to customer sites to install, program, wire, and commission robotic cells - Own the integration from mechanical setup through software configuration -- fixtures, I/O, PLC handshakes, safety, test, sign-off - Troubleshoot on-site when things don't go as planned (and sometimes they don't) -- you stay until it works Customer Training & Support - Train customer operators and technicians on Standard Bots hardware and software -- both on-site and at our facility - Support customers post-install as they find new applications and push the limits of what the robot can do - Be a trusted technical resource for the accounts you've worked with -- they'll call you when something comes up Trade Shows & Demos - Represent Standard Bots at industry events and trade shows -- build the demo, run it live, talk shop with engineers and plant managers on the floor - Help develop and maintain demo systems that show the breadth of what Standard Bots hardware can do Internal Collaboration - Feed real-world integration learnings back to our hardware and software engineering teams -- you're on the front lines and your input shapes the product - Assist in-house engineering with testing new features, peripherals, and integrations as we expand the platform What We're Looking For - A genuine trifecta: you're comfortable with mechanical systems, electrical systems, and software -- not just one of the three - 6+ years of hands-on experience with industrial automation fundamentals: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems (you know the difference between NPN and PNP), robot programming (any platform), and Python scripting - Proficiency with CAD -- SolidWorks preferred, but we care more that you can design and think in 3D than which tool you use - Customer-facing experience -- you can explain a technical integration to an engineer, a plant manager, and an ops director in the same conversation and land differently with each one - A genuine bias for getting things done in the field, not just in theory -- you'd rather build it than write about it - Comfort with up to 50% domestic travel; this role is hands-on and on-site by nature - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story Nice to Have - Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar) - Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications - Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling - Background in a manufacturing or production environment -- you've worked on or near a factory floor before Compensation and Benefits The salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

title: Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager

This role requires building multi-threaded executive relationships, leading global account strategy, and elevating customers into long-term strategic partnerships by delivering value through positive business outcomes. Retention & Expansion Growth Consistently exceed GRR and NRR quota through retention and expansion of existing clients. Partner with the Sales team to identify and convert Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) into expansion opportunities. Drive whitespace penetration and multi-entity expansion within global enterprises. Identify expansion opportunities, upsell, and renewal by understanding customer needs and aligning them with our product roadmap. Identify at-risk accounts early and develop strategies to mitigate churn. Global Cross-Functional Collaboration Foster collaboration across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Enterprise Services, Architects, COE, Product Management, and Marketing to gather feedback and advocate for client needs and strategic priorities. Mobilize executive sponsors, thought leaders, and cross-functional experts to bring the full value of Enable to Lighthouse customers. Deliver a white-glove customer experience through proactive, personalized engagement and seamless cross-functional coordination for high-value strategic customers. Executive Presence & Strategic Influence Demonstrate strong executive presence in board-level and C-suite conversations. Articulate business value, ROI, risk mitigation, operational efficiency, and strategic agility. Lead executive exchanges grounded in trust, open communication, and mutual value creation. Position Enable as a strategic advisory partner. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) Strong organizational and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability coordinate several senior stakeholders both internally and externally. Executive-level communication and relationship building skills with the ability to establish credibility and influence C-Suite stakeholders. Exceptional prioritization skills to balance internal projects and act as an escalation point for team and customer concerns. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to balance team and customer success with company needs and opportunities. Adaptability to thrive in a fast-changing environment. Required Education and Experience 6+ years of experience in the SaaS industry with proven Customer Success management background. Proven experience managing customers across Strategic and Enterprise segments. Proven success developing and executing strategic account plans that have delivered measurable retention and expansion outcomes. Experience partnering with Revenue teams on renewals, upselling and account growth. Preferred Education and Experience Prior experience in the rebate, pricing, or supply chain industry. Familiarity with Enable’s (including Flintfox) offerings and customer base. Advanced training or certifications in Customer Success or related fields. Experience applying Force Management, MEDDPICC or comparable enterprise account-management methodologies. Travel 25%. You will be required to meet with customers or attend company events. You are expected to be face to face (on-site) with customers as much as possible. Compensation Additional Information Total Rewards: At Enable, we’re committed to your professional development and growth. Starting pay is determined by factors like location, skills, experience, market conditions, and internal parity. Salary/TCC is just one component of Enable’s total rewards package. Enable is committed to investing in the holistic health and wellbeing of all Enablees and their families. Our benefits and perks include, but are not limited to: Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to relax and recharge Comprehensive Insurance: Health and life coverage for you and your family Retirement Plan: Build your future with our retirement savings plan Lucrative Bonus Plan: Enjoy a rewarding bonus structure subject to company or individual performance Equity Program: Benefit from our equity program with additional options tied to tenure and performance Career Growth: Explore new opportunities with our internal mobility program Additional Perks: Training: Access a range of workshops and courses designed to boost your professional growth and take your career to new heights Pets: Bring your pets to our welcoming, pet-friendly offices According to LinkedIn's Gender Insights Report, women apply for 20% fewer jobs than men, despite similar job search behaviors.
