title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience. About the role Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly What are we looking for: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right. If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync. What would you do at Fever? During your first month at Fever (Onboarding period): You’ll join a structured onboarding program designed to help you ramp up smoothly. During this period, you will: Meet your buddy and team, and get to know Fever’s culture and ways of working. Set up your local environment and become familiar with our Python-based stack, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. Learn about our architecture and observability tools while contributing small improvements and fixes. Have your first code running in production and a clear understanding of our delivery flow and processes. By the end of the onboarding, you’ll be ready to join your long-term squad and start contributing to larger initiatives. After 3 months at Fever: You’ll be confidently collaborating and delivering at full speed. You will: Design and implement end-to-end features within your squad. Participate in architectural discussions and propose improvements across our services and APIs. Work with event-driven systems and focus on performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate closely with Product, Data, and other Engineering teams to enhance our platform and developer experience. By your 6th month at Fever: You’ll be fully established as a key contributor in your team. You will: Take ownership of core components and help evolve their architecture. Lead by example through code reviews, design sessions, and mentoring. Contribute to best practices in areas like scalability, observability, and system design. Drive continuous improvement and have a visible impact on how we build high-performing services at scale. Become an expert in your domain, using business context and technical excellence to drive strategic initiatives forward About you Must have skills: Strong knowledge of best practices, testing, and design patterns You are proficient in business English You know how to deliver code from development to production Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption) Knowledge of relational databases and SQL Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ Handling services with high concurrencies and high volume requests. We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in: Django/Flask PostgreSQL and Redis AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes Benefits & Perks 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday Private medical insurance sponsored by the company 40% discount on Fever Marketplace Flexibility to work from home English & Spanish conversational classes Wellhub (former Gympass) membership Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow Flexible remuneration with Cobee Budget for engineering events and trainings Young and international environment Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance. Base Salary: 50K - 75K EUR Total Compensation: 67K - 90K EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options) About the process Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like: Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture and a conversation about your background and experience. Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever. Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Lead AI Engineer
description: Hey there! We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. The Role We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to drive Fever's company-wide AI transformation. This is a powerful 50% leadership, 50% hands-on building role designed for someone who sits right at the intersection of human operations and advanced AI engineering. We are not looking for a theoretical manager who focus on KPIs, nor a developer who only wants to code in isolation. We need a hybrid leader. Half of your time will be spent interacting with stakeholders across business domains (Operations, Creative, Support), shadowing them to understand their manual workflows, and identifying where AI can genuinely give them their time back. The other half will be spent in the trenches: designing the technical architecture, writing production code, and building internal AI products—like advanced chatbots, agents, and automated workflows—alongside a small, high-performance squad.The Role What You'll Do Stakeholder Management & Discovery (50%): Partner with internal business leaders to audit their current manual processes. Act as a translator: understand their operational bottlenecks, manage expectations on what AI can do, and shape those needs into a clear AI product features. Hands-on Engineering & Architecture (50%): Design, code, and deploy advanced AI systems (LLM applications, agentic workflows, RAG, and custom chatbots) that solve those operational pain points and scale seamlessly. Lead & Mentor: Build and lead a small, agile team of AI engineers. Lead by example by contributing to the codebase, setting high standards for code craftsmanship, and fostering a culture of high-velocity shipping. You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
description: Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact. The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it. This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on. We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product. What You Will Own: Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations. Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability. The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly. Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team. Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment. Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform. Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation. Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by. What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months: High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve. description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work. We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box. You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes. Threat modeling and security reviews : run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions. Code analysis with LLMs : use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong. Build internal security tooling : contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself. Help engineers do the secure thing by default : answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop. On-call and incident response : share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents. Support the wider team : help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits. What You Will Bring to the Role Around 3+ years in security or software engineering , with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count). Experience at a SaaS or software product company , working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments. Hands-on vulnerability triage : you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration). Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services. You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review. You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security. Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists. Nice to haves Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools. Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus. Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation. Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes. Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse). Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software. title: Director, Business Development - Defence & Government (France)
description: Wanna join the adventure? This is a senior, hands-on role focused on building relationships with key government and military stakeholders, advancing existing opportunities, and developing new business across French defence programmes. You'll take ownership of Loft's engagements with organizations including the DGA , Ministry of Armed Forces and CNES , while also contributing to broader European and international defence, government, and strategic commercial opportunities. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of the French defence landscape, whether from a career in the military or government, or from working with these customers within the defence and aerospace industry. While France will be the primary focus, the role offers exposure to a broader range of government and commercial opportunities across Loft. Space experience is valuable, but understanding how to navigate the French government and defence ecosystem is essential. About the Role: Own the full sales cycle with French defence and government customers — from lead generation and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close. Build and deepen relationships across the Ministère des Armées, DGA , Commandement de l'Espace, Agence de l'innovation de défense (AID), CNES and the French prime contractors and integrators that serve them. Win through French public procurement; navigate tenders, innovation programmes and direct contracting routes, and position Loft early so requirements are shaped before formal calls are issued. Lead written and verbal proposals in French and English, translating mission requirements ( ISR , space domain awareness, communications, in-orbit demonstration, science, etc.) into a commercial offer that wins. Negotiate contracts with confidence, handling pricing, terms, security and sovereignty requirements, and deal structure without losing momentum. Identify and contribute to opportunities beyond the core French portfolio, including European defence programmes, allied government customers, and broader strategic partnerships where relevant. Stay close to accounts once programmes are underway, supporting customers and identifying additional opportunities as they emerge. Bring market intelligence back into the business — French and European defence and space priorities, budget cycles, competitor moves and where the market is heading. Must Haves: 5+ years of direct sales or business development experience selling complex technical products or solutions to French defence or government customers, ideally within aerospace, defence, space, or other deep-tech industries. An established network across the French defence and government ecosystem, particularly Minarm and DGA , with familiarity with organizations such as CDE and CNES and an understanding of how French defence programmes are planned, funded and procured. Proven track record of independently developing strategic opportunities, leading complex commercial negotiations, and securing significant institutional or government contracts. Technical understanding of defence, aerospace, intelligence or space systems, including the ability to engage with engineering stakeholders, understand system architectures and capabilities, and translate complex technical concepts into customer value. Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to represent an organization credibly in front of senior government, military, and industry leaders. Native or fully professional French and English, written and spoken. Eligible to obtain and hold a French national defence security clearance (habilitation). Nice to Haves: Experience selling mission- or satellite-as-a-service offerings to defence or institutional customers. Strong technical fluency in space hardware and systems — payload integration, spacecraft bus architecture, mission design — enough to earn credibility with engineers and programme officers. Direct experience at a French prime, a scaleup/startup in the space industry, the DGA , CNES or within the French armed forces. An interest in learning about everything and anything — our job is to make a customer's mission a reality, no matter what it is. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team. - Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates. - Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase. Delivery & Roadmap - Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones. - Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless. - Understand what developers need from a real-time API or SDK, and have shipped one to customers outside your company. - Have experience with Elixir, Erlang or BEAM (not required but a plus). - Have experience with Postgres logical replication and Row Level Security (not required but a plus). - Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones. - Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. title: Developer Relations Engineer
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code. We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly - Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix - Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform - Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team - Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF - You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge - You create content that makes people want to open their code editor - You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript - You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person - You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source REQUIREMENTS - Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.) - Experience creating technical content (written or video) - Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online) BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE - A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter - Prior experience in DevRel or open source - Have used (and loved) Supabase WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Principal Software Architect
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture. 🧠 Your day-to-day As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions. Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture. Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope. Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control. Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached. Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning. Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met. Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records. Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture. 🙌 You should apply if You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs. You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems. You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments. You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR. You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints. You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications. You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve. You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively. You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen Hiring Manager Interview Deep-dive technical interviews Final interview : mission & values alignment We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: (Senior) Account Manager - Existing Customers (all genders)
description: Description In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren. Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt. Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort. Über die Rolle Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten. Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts. Das erwartet dich Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte. Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss. Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen. Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern. Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline. Was du mitbringst B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive. Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich. Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst. Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln. Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren. Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Warum uns? Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener. Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum. Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit. Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben. Benefits 30 Urlaubstage Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶 Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕 We mean it! Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser. Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen. Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Growth Marketing Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>Growth Marketing is the activation and delivery arm of GitLab marketing: campaigns, regional and field marketing, lifecycle and product led growth, marketing engineering and operations, corporate events including Transcend, partner marketing, community programs and Co-Create. If a program connects GitLab to a customer or a buyer, it lives here, and the team is accountable for pipeline, first orders, Flex conversion and expansion, and post sale adoption.</p> <p>As Principal Growth Marketing Strategist you work directly with the VP of Growth Marketing as a strategic partner and operator. You hold the whole picture of the engine: the goals every function has committed to, the budget and where it is moving, the strategic projects that do not fit cleanly inside any one function, and the decisions that are waiting on an answer. You keep that picture current, you act on it when the VP is engaged elsewhere, and you use it to move work faster.</p> <p>This is an individual contributor role at the Principal level. You do not manage a team. You manage outcomes across ten functions through influence, judgment and follow through, and you are trusted to speak for Growth Marketing in rooms the VP cannot be in. The people on the leadership team are senior, experienced marketers; they will work with you because you make them faster and sharper, not because of the title.</p> <p>You will be effective in this role if you have led marketing yourself at a senior level, understand how a modern B2B software company makes money, are curious and hands on with AI in your own work, and can move between a budget trade off, a partner negotiation, a pipeline review and a keynote plan in the same day without losing the thread.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run Growth Marketing's operating rhythm: goals, business reviews, planning cycles and the metrics inspection behind them, so decisions get made, recorded and followed through.</li> <li>Track commitments across the leadership team between their 1:1s with the VP, so those conversations are about strategy rather than status.</li> <li>Own the strategic projects that matter to Growth Marketing and have no single functional home: scope them, find the owner or be the owner, and land them.</li> <li>Hold the budget picture across the team, prepare trade offs with a recommendation, and act within the authority the VP has delegated in writing.</li> <li>Represent Growth Marketing on the VP's behalf in pipeline reviews, cross functional planning and partner conversations; carry the position in and the decision out.</li> <li>Unblock functional leaders when the VP is engaged elsewhere, or stage the issue so it takes one conversation rather than three.</li> <li>Be a thinking partner to any functional leader who wants one, offered rather than assigned.</li> <li>Partner with marketing's AI Transformation Owner so AI adoption across Growth Marketing is visible, measured and moving.</li> <li>Prepare the VP for high stakes moments: executive updates, leadership material, keynotes, customer and partner meetings, with the numbers checked and the first draft written.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in B2B software marketing with senior leadership experience: you have owned a marketing function, a large program budget or a go to market motion, and you have been accountable for a pipeline or revenue number.</li> <li>Breadth across marketing. You have worked in or closely with demand and digital, field and events, lifecycle or product led growth, partner marketing and marketing operations, and you can hold a credible conversation with an expert in each.</li> <li>A track record of landing cross functional projects that nobody owned, through influence rather than authority, with executives, peers and individual contributors.</li> <li>Business fluency: you read a P&L, a pipeline report and a budget model comfortably, you understand consumption and subscription business models, and you can explain a trade off to a CFO in plain language.</li> <li>Program and operating rhythm experience: goal frameworks, business reviews, planning cycles, and the discipline to keep them honest without turning them into bureaucracy.</li> <li>Hands on AI fluency. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you have built or configured something with them, and you are curious about how they change the way a marketing organization operates. Prior experience in a chief of staff, strategy and operations, or business operations role is welcome but not required.</li> <li>Executive communication: concise writing, clear verbal briefs, comfort presenting to and being questioned by VPs and C level leaders, and the judgment to know what travels up and what does not.</li> <li>Discretion. You will handle confidential people, budget and strategy information every day.</li> <li>Familiarity with developer, DevOps or platform engineering audiences, or the ability to get there fast.</li> <li>The ability to use GitLab, and to travel occasionally for events and leadership offsites.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Growth Marketing at GitLab is one integrated engine of roughly 100 people across ten functions, led by the VP of Growth Marketing and reporting into the Chief Product and Marketing Officer. The team runs Transcend, GitLab's flagship event program, the GitHub competitive motion, the regional and partner marketing engines in AMER, EMEA and APJ, the lifecycle and product led growth motions behind GitLab's self serve business, and marketing's AI transformation. The leadership team operates on a small set of shared principles: speed with quality, an ownership mindset, and customer outcomes. You can read more about <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/marketing/">how marketing operates at GitLab</a> in the handbook.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Wir wollen, dass er sie bei uns findet — auf Social, auf YouTube, in Google, in KI-Antworten, in Fachmagazinen, in Bewertungen. Kampagnen erzeugen Aufmerksamkeit in Wellen. Du baust das, was bleibt: Inhalte, die in zwölf Monaten noch gefunden werden, und Sichtbarkeit, die sich auf addiert statt zu verpuffen. Du führst dabei unser Creator-Team und steuerst Influencer, Redaktionen und Agenturen. Social-Kanalaufbau : Du entwickelst unsere organischen Social-Kanäle und das Social Media Team weiter und baust neue auf: Formatentwicklung, Kanalstrategie, Frequenz, Community. Redaktionsplanung : Du erstellst den Redaktionsplan über alle organischen Kanäle. Du kümmerst dich um Themen, Timing, Ressourcen, Umsetzung und Priorisierung. Führung des Creator- und Influencer-Teams : Du führst unser Creator-Team: Zielsetzung, Feedback, Entwicklung, Kapazitätsplanung. Du verantwortest Influencer Marketing inklusive Creator Campaigns — von der Auswahl über Briefing und Beziehungspflege bis zur Auswertung. Longform und Evergreen : YouTube-Longform, Blog-Inhalte, Guides, Ratgeber. Du entwickelst die Formate, briefst und lässt produzieren — und produzierst mit, wo es schneller geht. Was Kampagnen und Produkt-Launches nicht abdecken, baust du eigenständig auf. Aus Kampagnenmaterial entwickelst du selbstständig Evergreen-Formate, ohne dass es dir jemand zuweist. PR und Earned Media : Fachmagazine, Online-Magazine, Vergleichsportale, Bewertungsplattformen, externe Blogbeiträge. Du baust Beziehungen zu Redaktionen und Plattformen auf und aktivierst Bewertungen. Edu-Creator und Tierärzt:innen bindest du als Glaubwürdigkeitsquelle ein. SEO und GEO : Du verantwortest unsere Sichtbarkeit in Suchmaschinen und in KI-generierten Antworten. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen und wo wir Lücken haben — und übersetzt das in den Redaktionsplan. Agentursteuerung : Du koordinierst externe Agenturen, Freelancer und Produktionspartner: Briefing, Qualität, Timing, Budget. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau von Short / Longform- und Evergreen-Content mit Instagram, Tiktok und YouTube Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Produzent:innen, Freelancer oder Agenturen Erfahrung in fachlicher oder disziplinarischer Führung eines Content- oder Creator-Teams Erfahrung in SEO — inhaltlich und technisch, nicht nur Keyword-Recherche Nachweisbares Verständnis für Sichtbarkeit in KI-Antworten (GEO / AI Search) und wie sie entsteht Redaktionelle Sorgfalt bei Gesundheitsthemen: du weißt, warum Quellen, Expertise und Nachvollziehbarkeit bei diesen Inhalten nicht verhandelbar sind Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch Du liebst Hunde und Katzen Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sustainability Consultant – PCF/LCA / Climate Tech (w/m/d)

Schulung von Kolleg:innen und Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams. Hauptansprechpartner:in für Kund:innen, inkl. Unterstützung bei weiteren Nachhaltigkeits‑Tools. Dein Profil Fließendes Deutsch (C2) und sehr gutes Englisch (C1). Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder in‑house mit Fokus PCF/LCA. Hands‑on‑Ownership von PCF/LCA‑Projekten von Daten bis Ergebnis – keine Weiterleitung. Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt und Projektmanagement. Fundierte Kenntnisse in ISO 14067, ISO 14040 bzw. PACT‑Standards. Builder‑Mindset: du verbesserst Prozesse aktiv und scheust nicht das Anpacken. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten. Was hier nicht funktioniert Purely academic LCA‑Profil – keine Praxis, kein Mehrwert. Manager‑Only‑Ansatz – delegiert technische Umsetzung, fehlt Hands‑on‑Mentalität. Fokus ausschließlich auf CSRD‑Reporting – keine Tiefe in PCF/LCA. Maintenance‑Mindset – keine Lust, Prozesse zu redesignen. Wohnort außerhalb der EU – rechtliche Hürden. Deine Benefits Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Direkter Beitrag zur CO₂‑Reduktion namhafter Unternehmen. Hohe Gestaltungsmacht: Aufbau und Skalierung des gesamten Beratungsprozesses. Modernes Climate‑Tech‑Umfeld: KI‑gestützte Plattform aktiv mitgestalten. Schnelle Verantwortung: End‑to‑End‑Projektverantwortung in einer kleinen, wachsenden Unit. Flexibles Arbeiten: 100 % Remote (Deutschland), flexible Zeiten, 28 Urlaubstage. Breites Kundenspektrum: Mittelstand bis Großkonzerne (z. B. Heraeus, Tchibo). Positives Team‑Setting: offene Kommunikation, regelmäßige Events, Wertschätzung von Eigeninitiative. Was diese Rolle besonders macht Du definierst den gesamten PCF/LCA‑Beratungsprozess selbst. Du arbeitest mit einer KI‑basierten Plattform, die die Branche revolutioniert. Du erhältst sofortige End‑to‑End‑Verantwortung und rasche Aufstiegschancen. Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen. Bereit? Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Sustainability Consultant – PCF/LCA / Climate Tech (w/m/d). title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Hauts de France (gn)
description: For this position we source for our sister company Troostwijk. About us Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support. What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business. The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market. You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships. What this means in practice Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market. Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust. Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations. Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers. Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps. Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion. Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools. Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams. What matters in this role We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward. What you should bring Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition. Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results. Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills. Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach. Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence. French as a native language and the ability to work in English. A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business. What we offer Autonomy with professional support You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions. Build something with visible impact The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development. Performance that pays off You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance. Your benefits Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work. Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: DevSecOps Engineer (all genders) 100% Homeoffice
description: Dein Team Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen. Bei der fino data services arbeitest du mit Menschen, die neugierig sind, schnell denken und Dinge gerne selbst in die Hand nehmen. Die sich festbeißen, wenn etwas spannend wird, ihre Ideen laut aussprechen und nicht beim ersten Lösungsansatz aufhören. Hier treffen unterschiedliche Köpfe, Perspektiven und Stärken aufeinander. Wir diskutieren, challengen uns, lernen voneinander und bauen gemeinsam Lösungen, die wirklich etwas verändern. Du bekommst dabei nicht nur ein Team, sondern Rückenwind für deine Ideen, Raum zum Ausprobieren und Menschen, die mit dir aus einer guten Idee etwas Besonderes machen. Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leuten zu arbeiten, die genauso viel vorhaben wie du: Willkommen bei der fino data services. Aufgaben Was du bei uns verantwortest Security Monitoring im Tagesgeschäft Du überwachst täglich und hands-on unsere Security-Dashboards und hast den Sicherheitsstatus unserer Systeme jederzeit im Blick. Du erkennst Auffälligkeiten frühzeitig, bewertest sie und leitest selbst die nötigen Schritte ein, statt sie nur weiterzugeben. Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards, Alerts und Kennzahlen weiter, damit relevante Signale nicht im Rauschen untergehen. Im Ernstfall behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest Sicherheitsvorfälle strukturiert ab. Sicherheit in der Pipeline Du verankerst Sicherheitsprüfungen fest in unseren CI/CD-Pipelines, von statischer Code-Analyse (SAST) über dynamische Tests (DAST) bis zur Prüfung von Abhängigkeiten (SCA). Du wählst die passenden Werkzeuge aus und legst fest, welche Befunde einen Build stoppen. So schützt Sicherheit unsere Teams, statt sie auszubremsen. Du bewertest Schwachstellen nach ihrem tatsächlichen Risiko und sorgst dafür, dass das Wichtige zuerst erledigt wird. Software-Lieferkette & Infrastruktur Du sicherst unsere Software-Lieferkette ab: Abhängigkeiten, Build-Artefakte und Container-Images werden nachvollziehbar dokumentiert (SBOM) und signiert. Du bringst unser Secrets Management auf ein sauberes Niveau: Passwörter, Zertifikate und API-Schlüssel gehören in einen Tresor, nicht in den Code. Du härtest Container- und Cloud-Umgebungen, vergibst Rechte nach dem Least-Privilege-Prinzip und erkennst Fehlkonfigurationen, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Du schreibst Sicherheitsregeln als Code fest und setzt sie automatisiert durch (Policy as Code). Security-Kultur & Compliance Du führst gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungsteams Threat Modelings durch, schulst und baust Security Champions auf. Du unterstützt die technische Umsetzung und den Nachweis der Anforderungen unserer ISO-Zertifizierung. Du sorgst dafür, dass auch KI-generierter Code und KI-Agenten sicher in unsere Prozesse eingebunden sind, und behältst regulatorische Anforderungen wie den Cyber Resilience Act im Blick. Qualifikation Ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä., eine IT-Ausbildung (z. B. in der Fachinformatik) oder einen vergleichbaren Weg. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst. Mehrjährige Praxis in Softwareentwicklung, DevOps oder Plattformbetrieb: Du hast selbst Code geschrieben und Systeme betrieben. Fundiertes Security-Know-how: OWASP Top 10 in der Praxis, Threat Modeling, Cloud- und Container-Security. Erfahrung im aktiven Security Monitoring: Du arbeitest gern täglich mit Dashboards, Logs und Alerts und gehst Auffälligkeiten selbst auf den Grund. Erfahrung mit CI/CD (z. B. GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions), Docker und Kubernetes sowie Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform). Sicher in mindestens einer Programmier- oder Skriptsprache wie Python, Go oder Bash; Erfahrung mit Elixir/Phoenix ist ein Plus. Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Tools wie Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, HashiCorp Vault, Sigstore oder OPA sowie Zertifizierungen wie CKS. Überzeugen statt anordnen: Du erklärst unseren Entwicklungsteams, warum der Build rot ist, und dem Management, welches Risiko im nächsten Release steckt. Du setzt klare Prioritäten, auch wenn hunderte Befunde offen sind. Sprachen: sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Bereitschaft, regelmäßig an unseren Teamtagen teilzunehmen. Benefits Was wir bieten: Klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Unterstützung: Bei uns weißt du genau, was von dir erwartet wird, und du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Fehler als wertvolle Lernchancen betrachtet werden. Gemeinschaftliches Engagement für außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse: Unser Team strebt leidenschaftlich nach Spitzenleistungen und sieht deinen Beitrag als unverzichtbar an. Gemeinsam erreichen wir Großartiges. Individuelle Entwicklung und Selbstverantwortung: Wir fördern Selbstmotivation und deine persönliche Verantwortung, um herausragende Leistungen zu erzielen. title: Technical Integrations Manager
description: At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust. We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to. Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong. What you will do: Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner. Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one. Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast. Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval. Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest. Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work. Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks. Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us. Who you are: You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations. You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check. You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability. You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call. You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete. You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster. Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above. Why join us now? We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast ; The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide; We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score ; We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees. Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio. provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs</li> <li>Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity
