improvements to quality and engineering processes</li> <li>Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action</li> <li>Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions </li> <li>Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes</li> <li>Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company</li> <li>Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record </li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security</li> <li>Leadership and management ability</li> <li>Excellent business English writing and presentation skills</li> <li>Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management</li> <li>Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks</li> <li>Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk</li> <li>Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Create: Change Record
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/devops/create/source-code/change-record/">Change Record</a> team within GitLab’s <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/devops/create/source-code/">Source Code stage</a>. As AI agents increasingly write code alongside people, every change needs a clear, trustworthy record of what changed, why, and who or what made it. You’ll build that record into GitLab’s source code experience, for humans and agents alike. This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development.</p> <p>That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories behind a large share of GitLab traffic, so you’ll help keep it reliable through performance tuning, caching, rate limiting, observability, and resiliency, collaborating with product, design, security, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience teams. Supporting production systems and improving established experiences are central to the role, especially while you’re onboarding, and over time you’ll also help build experiences for developers working with agents.</p> <p>You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby on Rails and GraphQL, among other technologies.</li> <li>Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.</li> <li>Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows.</li> <li>Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.</li> <li>Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.</li> <li>Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.</li> <li>Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.</li> <li>An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.</li> <li>Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems.</li> <li>Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.</li> <li>Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output.</li> <li>Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. We work closely with other Source Code teams, Agentic Preview, Repository Services, and Hardening, as well as other teams in the company such as the Gitaly team, and the AI Governance team.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.</em></p> <p><em><strong>Poland base salary range:</strong> 248,000zł - 372,000zł</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. title: Vulnerability Strategy Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250  + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As VAIB Strategy Analyst, you will play a critical role in fulfilling Monzo's mission to make money work for everyone by driving meaningful improvements for customers requiring additional support. Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Strategic Delivery:</strong> Take ownership of complex VAIB workstreams, translating strategic priorities into clear delivery plans and driving improvements that balance customer needs, regulatory expectations, and operational goals.</li> <li><strong>Drive Data-Led Improvements:</strong> Analyze quantitative data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify systemic barriers, proactively monitor outcomes, and develop evidence-based recommendations for strategic change.</li> <li><strong>Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Operations to build VAIB awareness, influence decision-making, and embed inclusive considerations into the design of customer journeys and internal processes.</li> <li><strong>Navigate Complex Escalations:</strong> Act as the escalation point for complex, ambiguous customer or operational issues, applying strong independent judgement to recommend proportionate solutions when clear policy guidance is unavailable.</li> <li><strong>Own Governance and Risk:</strong> Manage control requirements for all strategic changes, ensuring work is rigorously assessed, documented, and governed to support informed decision-making and mitigate regulatory risk.</li> <li><strong>Coach and Build Capability:</strong> Strengthen the wider VAIB team by proactively sharing specialist knowledge, mentoring less experienced colleagues, and elevating overall analytical and strategic ways of working.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep subject matter expertise in VAIB and relevant legal frameworks (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG), applying this knowledge to identify systemic barriers and proactively recommend improvements to products and customer journeys. VAIB experience is preferable but we'd also love to hear from you if you have any other regulatory background. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to independently manage and deliver complex strategic initiatives, utilising quantitative data, customer insights, and operational feedback to investigate ambiguous challenges, resolve blockers, and implement practical solutions.</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and assurance, paired with excellent decision-making skills to confidently navigate ambiguity, appropriately mitigate risks, and ensure complex decisions are effectively balanced and documented.</li> <li>You are highly skilled in stakeholder management and communication, with the ability to clearly convey sensitive information, constructively challenge existing approaches, and drive alignment across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering.</li> <li>You are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for vulnerable customers, coupled with a dedication to sharing expertise and coaching colleagues to build the overall capability and confidence of the wider team.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. title: Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.</p> <p>We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.</p> <p>The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.</p> <p>Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.</p> <p>This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code</li> <li>Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications</li> <li>Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure</li> <li>Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community</li> <li>Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code</li> <li>Follow agile software development practices</li> <li>Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights</li> <li>Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values</li> <li>Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You are a passionate Python developer</li> <li>You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software</li> <li>You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world</li> <li>You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies</li> <li>You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>You are a lifelong learner</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points for</h3> <ul> <li>You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field</li> <li>Golang programming skills</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

title: Product Designer
description: Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX. 📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries . Hybrid option available in the Netherlands. Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions. Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide. Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains. title: Global Mobility Manager
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models. That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale. This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here. This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own mobility, end to end - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources Power global expansion - Support our expansion into new markets by: - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets Build the partnerships and the program - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve Make it visible and make it automatic - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely - You're comfortable with the compliance side of expansion: local employment law, entity setup, and employment models - You have excellent judgment and discretion, and your writing is concise enough to help partners move fast - You take ownership and run with it. You have real agency: you spot what needs to happen, act with urgency, and drive it to done without waiting to be asked - You know how to influence leaders. You bring data, a clear point of view, and a recommendation to senior stakeholders and help them make fast, confident decisions on mobility and expansion - You're direct and kind. You have strong opinions, loosely held, and you like to collaborate - Bonus: you've supported a company through its first international expansions or entities Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If you're a builder at heart, share our values, and get excited about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 - $200,000. You'll take on complex, open-ended go-to-market questions with limited context, working directly with executive partners across Sales, Finance, and Product to decide where to invest, how to reach customers, and what needs to change.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Shape revenue strategy across customer segmentation, sales coverage, sales motions, and investment priorities.</li> <li>Design multi-quarter changes in how we sell and monetize, defining the implications for the customer journey, metrics, roles, incentives, and operating model. Build agreement on the path forward and partner with Field Operations and Enablement on execution.</li> <li>Develop market and expansion strategies, prioritizing markets, defining go-to-market models and capacity needs, and identifying the operational dependencies of entering or scaling in new regions.</li> <li>Connect go-to-market strategy and Product by translating field and customer insights into product input, and product direction into commercial implications. Provide focused, commercially grounded input on pricing and packaging.</li> <li>Contribute strategic inputs to long-range planning, including total addressable market, sales capacity, productivity, and unit economics, while Field Operations and Finance retain ownership of annual planning, quota setting, and territory design.</li> <li>Build models, write decision memos, run analyses, and facilitate working sessions to turn recommendations into action with cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Advise senior leaders in Sales, Finance, and Product independently, distilling complex problems into clear recommendations with explicit assumptions and trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex go-to-market or revenue strategy work in a growing technology company, consulting, or a combination of both. Relevant experience and transferable skills matter more than a particular career path.</li> <li>Direct experience solving business-to-business software go-to-market problems, such as segmentation, coverage, pipeline and conversion, sales capacity and productivity, incentives, or pricing and packaging.</li> <li>A structured approach to testing assumptions and turning an unclear problem into a framework, a recommendation, and practical next steps.</li> <li>Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to build models and recognize when the evidence is sufficient to make a decision.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence, and influence people without formal authority.</li> <li>A collaborative, hands-on approach that treats execution as part of strategy, not a handoff after the recommendation.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience with usage-based or consumption models, international expansion, enterprise or platform sales, or a technical or scientific background. Interest in people management over time is welcome, but this is an individual contributor role.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Revenue Strategy team tackles strategic questions about how GitLab reaches customers, sells, and monetizes its platform. You'll work with Sales, Finance, and Product leaders to connect strategy with commercial decisions, and with Field Operations and Enablement to put those decisions into practice. GitLab is an all-remote company with a public handbook and a transparent, low-ego culture. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Iterable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Lifecycle Marketing team creates personalized, scalable programs to engage prospects, customers, and users at every stage of their title: Lead Product Marketing Manager, Core Product
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day. - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it. - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms. - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights. - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field. - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function. - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market. - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company. - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches. - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome. - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done. - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands. NICE TO HAVES: - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community. - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond. - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs. - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: At Notion, we believe in building software that adapts to how people work, not the other way around. As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships. We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to turn our global enablement strategy into repeatable programs that drive measurable changes in how our revenue teams work. You'll maintain a consistent global core while tailoring examples, facilitation, sequencing, and practice to the market. You'll partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, onboarding teams, and frontline managers to equip the field with the skills, workflows, and just-in-time guidance to execute our GTM strategy. You'll design for practice and proficiency, enable managers to coach and reinforce new behaviors, and use adoption and business signals to continuously improve programs. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: Global Program Development & Implementation - Champion our global operating cadence to ensure the AMER region is successfully executing our GTM strategy - Design, develop, and program manage comprehensive enablement programs that can be deployed globally and execute them in AMER while maintaining consistency in our selling methodology and GTM goals - Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, and subject matter experts to build scalable curricula, hands-on practice, certification, and continuous learning programs that demonstrate role-based proficiency - Contribute to and maintain the global sales playbook in partnership with its owners, ensuring it reflects practical, repeatable practices across markets - Use AI, automation, and reusable agent-enabled workflows to deliver just-in-time guidance and reinforcement in the tools and workflows revenue teams already use - Define the behaviors each program should change and measure leading indicators such as completion, proficiency, adoption, manager activation, and resource usage alongside downstream outcomes such as time to ramp and productivity. Review results regularly, distinguish correlation from causation, and recommend corrective action when adoption or performance is off track - Lead cross-functional initiatives to align product releases, go-to-market strategies, and enablement rollouts - Partner with onboarding teams to reinforce role-based ramp milestones through hands-on application, practice, and proficiency checks - Build technical and workflow fluency programs that help the field uncover customer needs, translate business problems into practical Notion workflows, and demonstrate their value - Activate frontline managers first with previews, toolkits, coaching prompts, and consistent reinforcement and inspection cadences AMER activation & regional adaptation - Collaborate with regional segment leads to proactively identify segment & market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer behavior patterns - Adapt global programs to address regional needs while maintaining core methodology and brand consistency - Create region-specific content, case studies, and competitive battle cards that resonate with local markets - Build feedback loops between regional teams and global program development to continuously improve our approach - Partner with regional managers to coach, inspect, and reinforce priority behaviors in existing team cadences; use field feedback to improve adoption and program design SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: Experience & Expertise - 7-10+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar go-to-market roles - Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple geographies, with a consistent global core and effective regional adaptation - Expertise in adult learning methodologies and designing multimodal experiences that build and assess proficiency through practice, application, and reinforcement - High proficiency with the enablement tool stack including emerging AI and automation solutions (ideally AI is already embedded into your workflow) - Experience working with global sales teams and understanding of diverse market dynamics - Strong analytical skills and experience defining target behaviors, tracking leading indicators and business outcomes, and improving programs based on evidence Skills & Qualities - Demonstrate ability to build and automate Enablement and field work through AI workflows - Strategic thinker who can balance global consistency with local relevance - Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable working with senior leadership - Natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments - Data-driven approach to decision making with strong attention to detail - Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment - Passionate about developing people and helping teams reach their potential Technical Requirements - Proficiency with AI tools for workflow development, gamification, content creation, data analysis, and process automation - Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously - Experience enabling frontline managers to coach and reinforce new behaviors - Ability to build or support technical and workflow fluency programs that connect customer needs to practical solutions - Comfortable with sales analytics and performance metrics NICE TO HAVES: - Experience at a high-growth SaaS company - Background in sales, customer success, or revenue-generating roles - International work experience or familiarity with diverse cultural business practices - Experience with Notion or similar productivity tools - Certification in sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, etc.) Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Notion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $205,000 - $245,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts. We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings. What you’ll do - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners What we’re looking for - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run - Willingness to travel often, including evenings What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Paid co-working space or desk - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites - Remote-first with no required commute Learn how we think and work - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app. Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse. You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant. - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production. - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping. - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation. - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works. - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions. - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice. - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it. - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts. - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting. - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience. - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility. - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype. - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers. - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost. - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences. - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions. - Know Postgres and relational database practice. - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector. - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped. - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents. - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates. - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained. - Experience across several product surfaces or teams. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: CRM Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/UK Remote | 💰£57,000 - £77,000 (Dependent On Experience) + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a proactive and passionate CRM Manager to help us deliver CRM campaigns across Monzo's products offerings. </p> <p>The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of customer engagement and retention with previous experience launching targeted, data-driven campaigns across multiple channels, including email, push notifications, and in-app.</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our CRM team<br></strong><strong><br></strong>We are a fast growing team on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re responsible for designing high-impact communications across our products and the customer lifecycle to bring our Monzo magic to life.<br><br>We’re a hands on and highly collaborative team, working with lots of different folks across Monzo to drive innovation and automation of our messaging. We’re driven by data and excited by experimentation. This role is a great opportunity to help shape the future of our engagement strategy and programmes at Monzo.<br><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Executing customer lifecycle CRM journeys across multiple touch points</li> <li>Working closely with team members to collaborate and help deliver a range of campaigns across multiple channels</li> <li>Monitoring campaign performance and ensuring campaigns are executed safely </li> <li>Supporting Campaign QA (helping to check set-up thoroughly as a second pair of eyes before launch)</li> <li>Collaborating with other CRM Managers in developing effective segmentation strategies to target relevant audiences for each campaign</li> <li>Delivering campaigns with a test and learn data driven approach</li> <li>Owning existing processes and always-on campaigns within the team, and keeping these documented and up to date</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if …</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands on experience in CRM, with a proven track record of designing and implementing successful campaigns and automated journeys</li> <li>You have experience using a CRM platform for delivery (Braze, ideally)</li> <li>You have Fintech or Financial Services experience </li> <li>You have strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate hypotheses, and inform strategic decisions, Looker experience is an advantage </li> <li>You can demonstrate experience working with product teams across various areas, ensuring strategic alignment and customer-centric initiatives</li> <li>You bring excellent organisational and time management skills, with a keen eye for detail and ability to manage multiple priorities</li> <li>You can to organise priorities with stakeholders effectively</li> <li>You take a collaborative approach, working with all relevant stakeholders to deliver an end result that is right for the customer</li> <li>You have a Problem Solving mindset - able to solve potential problems or suggest alternative ways to achieve the desired outcome</li> <li>You're excited about what we do at Monzo</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £57,000 - £77,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30 minute chat with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>30 minute call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Full Loop: 1 x Role Specific Interview (60 mins) + 1 x Behaviours Interview (45 mins)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>⏳We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong><br></strong>#LI-REMOTE</p> <p>#CM-1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer (76080)
description: Wir suchen für einen Kunden einen erfahrenen Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer. title: PEGA Spezialist als Lead Business & System Architect (76037)
description: Für einen Kunden aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Pega Lead Business & System Architect. Bei diesem langfristigen Projekteinsatz spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Geschäftsanwendungen. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit mit 5–10 Jahren Praxiserfahrung, die unsere Kunden bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung innovativer Pega-Lösungen begleitet und nachhaltige digitale Transformationen vorantreibt. In dieser Position verbinden Sie Business und IT, übersetzen komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungsarchitekturen und überzeugen durch Ihre starke Beratungskompetenz sowie Ihren ausgeprägten Consulting Background. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p>As a Technical Recruiter, you'll help GitLab build the engineering and product teams behind our DevSecOps platform. In this individual contributor role, you'll partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Security, and UX and own searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines and use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, while growing into a trusted talent advisor.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage full-cycle searches for roles such as Backend and Frontend Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Security Engineers, Data Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers, delivering against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li> <li>Lead intake and kickoff conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, technical requirements, team context, interview plans, and timelines, with senior team guidance as needed.</li> <li>Partner with hiring teams on structured, equitable technical interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback; challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li> <li>Use talent-market research, compensation benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy and address hiring issues.</li> <li>Assess technical candidates on depth of experience, scope and impact of past work, problem-solving, and open source or community contributions, and how well their skills fit GitLab's teams and technology.</li> <li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing plans that balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, and targeted outreach across technical communities and specialized talent pools.</li> <li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation, equity, and benefits.</li> <li>Improve recruiting practices by sharing learnings and reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intermediate-level recruiting experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle searches independently.</li> <li>Technical recruiting experience, or a strong interest in learning engineering and product disciplines, tech stacks, team structures, and how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Developing advisor skills: building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations.</li> <li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines for hard-to-fill or specialized roles.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that turns funnel insights into practical actions.</li> <li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li> <li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, or comparable platforms; ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li> <li>Experience recruiting for DevSecOps, developer tools, or open source software is helpful, not required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>We work in a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Our team members share learnings and create reusable resources to improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Research & Development.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Head of Ecosystem
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform. You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: - Build and lead a new engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows - Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations - Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities - Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy - Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace - Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, issue tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners WHAT YOU BRING: - Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers - Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production - Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no - Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers - Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty - Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams - Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable Bonus points if you: - Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces - Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem - Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
