title: Backend Engineer (Python),AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer (Python) in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers the reusable building blocks agents and flows are made from as well as our core harness, Duo Developer.</p> <p>Most of your work will be backend engineering in Python, using libraries such as LangGraph to build secure, reliable and scalable features in our AI Gateway. You'll also work across the stack where needed. You'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the Duo Workflow Service, the AI Gateway and, where needed, the GitLab monolith. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.</li> <li>Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.</li> <li>Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.</li> <li>Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Join Tier 2 <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/incident-management/on-call/tier-2/">on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.</li> <li>Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and/or JavaScript and Vue is a plus.</li> <li>Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations stage</a> builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution. Between them, they own the GitLab Duo Developer foundational flow and the Flow Registry; the AI Catalog, including custom agents, custom flows and external agent integrations; and agent execution, agent tools and agent observability.</p> <p>Our engineers work async-first across EMEA, AMER, and India timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert. Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden. Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen. Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt. Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/ . Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich. Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen. Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? title: Product Manager - Postgres
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security. You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition. This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky. - You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected. - You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix. - You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions. - You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs. - You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call. - You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch. - You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions. - Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones. - Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion. - Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use. - Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Worked on a managed database service. - Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response. - Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products. - Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Principal Strategic Sourcing Lead - Technology
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Principal Strategic Sourcing - Technology, you'll lead GitLab's sourcing strategy for hyperscalers, cloud marketplaces, and artificial intelligence (AI) suppliers, some of our largest and fastest-growing areas of spend. You'll own negotiations and supplier lifecycle management, working with executives on both sides of the table to secure agreements that balance cost, flexibility, and speed.</p> <p>You'll partner with FinOps, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, and Legal to turn hyperscaler commitments, marketplace programs, and AI pricing models into a competitive advantage. This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Procurement and Strategic Sourcing.</p> <p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100 trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. We embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the sourcing strategy for hyperscalers, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud, cloud marketplaces, and AI suppliers such as foundation model providers, inference platforms, and AI-powered developer tools.</li> <li>Lead high-value, multi-year negotiations covering committed-spend agreements, enterprise discount programs, marketplace private offers, and usage-based or flexible AI pricing.</li> <li>Build executive relationships with strategic suppliers and lead business reviews covering performance, roadmaps, and commercial terms.</li> <li>Partner with FinOps and Engineering to forecast consumption, track usage against spending commitments, and optimize spend across committed, flexible, and pay-as-you-go models.</li> <li>Work with Go-to-Market teams to maximize the value of marketplace programs, co-selling opportunities, and cloud partnerships.</li> <li>Partner with Finance and Legal on deal structure, budgets, purchase orders, risk, and contract terms.</li> <li>Present sourcing strategies, deal recommendations, and savings results to executive leadership.</li> <li>Establish and improve sourcing processes, approval workflows, and governance for technology and AI spend.</li> <li>Track cloud and AI pricing, capacity, and supplier trends, and use those insights to shape proactive sourcing strategies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or technology vendor management, including at least 3 years leading large technology deals.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on experience negotiating hyperscaler agreements, including committed-spend agreements, enterprise discount programs, and cloud credits.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure marketplaces, including private offers and how marketplace spend counts toward spending commitments.</li> <li>Experience sourcing foundation model application programming interfaces (APIs) and inference platforms, with fluency in token-based, consumption, and reserved-capacity pricing.</li> <li>A track record of closing multi-million-dollar, multi-year agreements with measurable savings and value.</li> <li>Confidence engaging and influencing executives, both internally and at suppliers, and strong partnership skills across FinOps, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, and Legal.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills in total cost of ownership, consumption forecasting, and deal modeling.</li> <li>The ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, with transparency and collaboration as defined in the<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/"> GitLab Handbook</a>.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience at a software-as-a-service (SaaS) or AI-focused company.</li> <li>FinOps certification.</li> <li>Experience with procurement tools such as Zip.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>GitLab's Global Procurement organization is a 100% remote team that helps the company move fast and invest wisely. We partner with teams across GitLab to source, negotiate, and manage the suppliers behind our products, operations, and growth. We treat every dollar as an investment, focusing on total value, flexibility, and long-term partnerships.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, Customer Ops & Specialist Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. <strong>We are recruiting for 4 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: Complaints, VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements), Financial Health and Core Customer Operations. <br><br></strong>Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.</p> <p>We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. </p> <p>Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.</p> <p><strong><br>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a dedicated oversight team:</strong> You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.</li> <li><strong>Managing the partnership day to day:</strong> You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.</li> <li><strong>Acting as the translation layer:</strong> You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.</li> <li><strong>Tracking and managing performance:</strong> You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.</li> <li><strong>Forecasting and planning:</strong> Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Owning change execution:</strong> You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.</li> <li><strong>Integrating the teams:</strong> You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.</li> <li>You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.</li> <li>You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.</li> <li>You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.<strong><em><br><br></em></strong></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. title: Senior Contracts Manager
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own vendor contracting end to end - Review, draft, and negotiate a high volume of vendor agreements, including MSAs, order forms, SOWs, SaaS and cloud subscription terms, DPAs, and NDAs. - Serve as the single point of contact for all vendor contracting matters raised by FinOps, IT, Security, and business owners, from intake through signature, renewals, amendments, disputes, and offboarding. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters. - Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk. - Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it. - Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes. Build and scale vendor contracting operations - Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks. - Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps. - Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks. - Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required - 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms. - A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace. - Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers. - Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow. - Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate. - Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information. Preferred - A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree. - Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side. - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance. - Experience working across jurisdictions or with distributed, international teams. - Experience at a fast-growing, developer-focused, cloud, security, or open source company. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: External Partnerships & Engagement Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250  + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As External Partnerships & Engagement Manager, you will strategically manage a portfolio of VAIB partnerships that bring vital specialist expertise and enhanced support to Monzo's most vulnerable customers. You will proactively identify new partnership opportunities while leveraging data and customer feedback to continuously monitor and maximize the value of your existing relationships. Ultimately, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate this external insight and lived experience into tangible, practical improvements across our products, services, and customer journeys.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage Partnership Lifecycles:</strong> Own the end-to-end portfolio of VAIB external partnerships, from identifying strategic opportunities to onboarding, ongoing relationship management, and appropriate exits.</li> <li><strong>Drive Data-Led Impact:</strong> Continuously evaluate partnership performance using data and operational feedback, clearly reporting successes and confidently acting to strengthen or stop underperforming relationships.</li> <li><strong>Oversee Governance and Risk:</strong> Partner with Supplier Operations to conduct robust due diligence, ensuring all external relationships strictly adhere to Monzo’s risk, governance, and regulatory expectations.</li> <li><strong>Translate Insights into Action:</strong> Leverage specialist partner knowledge to identify opportunities and drive tangible improvements across vulnerable customer journeys, products, and support strategies.</li> <li><strong>Lead Lived-Experience Research:</strong> Own the Signposting Standard and collaborate with the Research team to capture lived experiences, turning best-practice insights into clear cross-functional recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Community Engagement:</strong> Plan external awareness campaigns, host expert listening sessions, and collaborate with Public Policy and Communications to amplify Monzo's impact and support media activity.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a deep understanding of VAIB principles and the barriers vulnerable customers face, driven by a strong commitment to improving customer outcomes through meaningful external collaboration.</li> <li>You have proven experience managing external relationships, going beyond relationship-building to set clear objectives, build trust, and hold both internal and external stakeholders accountable for delivering measurable benefits.</li> <li>You have experience evaluating partnership effectiveness using data and customer feedback, and are highly skilled at translating external expertise and lived experiences into practical, actionable recommendations for teams across Monzo.</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of due diligence and risk management, ensuring all external partnerships are supported by rigorous governance and robust, accurate documentation.</li> <li>You are a highly organised problem-solver capable of managing multiple competing priorities, confidently navigating challenging stakeholder conversations, and proactively course-correcting when partnerships fail to deliver their intended value.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description: About Us We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health. Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today. By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company. Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B. We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where" . Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare. Role overview Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution. What Youâll Do Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows. Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas. Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas. Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs. Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance. Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions. Accounts receivable and collections Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines. Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements. Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution. Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB. Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution. Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process. Quality and team development Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance. Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues. Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows. Basic Qualifications Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations. Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB). Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs. Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets. Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve. Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements. Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams. Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities. Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams. Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows. Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity. Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training. title: Senior Product Manager
description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Key responsibilities Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse. Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework. Your background You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through: A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there. Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with. Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working. A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role. A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant. Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus. You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires; Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows; Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them. Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive. Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability. KPIs & Success Measures We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output: Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%. Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%. Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%. First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days. Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs. Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble. Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%. Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%. Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%. Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%. Benefits 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees Flexible working hours Deep Dive About Pencil Pencil uses AI to make ads. title: Chief Information Security Officer
description: Who We Are Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital. The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page. Role summary Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong. The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers. You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure. What you will own Core security leadership (about half) Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on. Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises. Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline. Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data. Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in. Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders. Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products. Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job. Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording. AI-driven security (about half) Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged. Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work. AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them. Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live. AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents. Scope This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams. Requirements What you will bring Must have 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people. Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident. Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response. AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over. Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code. Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security. Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs. Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks. Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through. Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow. Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones. Nice to have Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production. Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers. Has run a brand protection or takedown program. Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense. Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP. title: GTM, Strategic Planning
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search — all deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're building the best developer platform to power the next generation of software companies, and our go-to-market team is scaling fast to match. We're looking for a lead in Go-To-Market Strategic Planning, to shape how Supabase's GTM engine runs. This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution. You'll work directly with Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Partnerships and Product to build the systems, processes, and insights that help our go-to-market teams move faster and smarter. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the end-to-end GTM Strategic Planning, covering territory design, segmentation design, target planning and GTM capacity planning. - Build and maintain a single source of truth for planning data across HubSpot, BigQuery and Hex. - Translate company priorities into field actions through designing the planning strategy and seeing it through to execution. - Partner with Sales Leadership to design and iterate on coverage models, segmentation, and team structures that reflect how developers actually buy. - Define and track the metrics that matter, and surface insights that drive action, not just reporting. - Lead the Strategic Planning roadmap: guide and lead in tooling investments and evaluate new systems and processes against real business needs. - Work cross-functionally with talent acquisition, ensuring GTM and territory models stay aligned. - Collaborate with GTM Engineering on automations and data pipelines so that your strategy translates into working systems, not just slide decks. WE'LL EXPECT YOU TO - Operate with high ownership. You set your own agenda, escalate when needed, and don't wait to be asked. - Work asynchronously and document clearly. We're a globally distributed team and writing is how we think. - Bridge strategy and execution. From drafting segmentation approaches in Google Docs to using SQL to monitor its effectiveness. - Build for scale without over-engineering. Simple systems that work beat perfect systems that don't ship. - Stay close to the customer. Developers are our buyers, and understanding how they discover, adopt, and expand is core to everything you'll do. YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU - Have 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Strategy Consulting, GTM Strategy, or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company. - Are fluent in the GTM stack: HubSpot, BigQuery, and Hightouch. - Can write SQL comfortably and aren't afraid to get into the data yourself before asking an analyst. - Have experience designing or overhauling sales processes, forecasting cadences, or territory models in a high-growth environment. - Understand product-led growth motions: PLS, usage-based triggers, and how PLG data flows into commercial pipelines. - Thrive with autonomy and are energized by building things that didn't exist before you joined. - Communicate with clarity across Finance, Sales, Success, Partnerships, Engineering, and Marketing without losing nuance. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
